Denkm. 24 ); ׳ מ absolute 2Kgs 18:22 + 223 t., הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה Exod 29:13 + 31 t.; construct מִזְבַּח Exod 20:24 + 76 t., suffix מִזְבְּחִי Exod 20:26 + 7 t., מִזְבַּחֲךָ 1Kgs 8:31 + 3 t., מִזְבְּחֶ֑ךָ Deut 33:10 מִזְבְּחוֺ Judg 6:31 + 2 t.; plural מִזְבְּחֹת Num 23:1 + 5 t., מִזְבְּחוֺת 2Kgs 21:3 + 23 t., suffix מִזְבְּחוֺתֶיךָ Ps 84:4 , other suffixes 21 t.; — 1. J E narrate that altars were built by Noah after leaving the ark Gen 8:20 by Abraham at Shechem Gen 12:7 , Bethel Gen 12:8 , Hebron Gen 13:18 , mountain in land Moriah Gen 22:9 by Issac at Beersheba Gen 26:25 by Jacob at Shechem Gen 33:20 (yet this perhaps mistake for מַצֵּבָה , being object of וַיַּצֶּבשָֿׁם , not elsewhere with מזבח , compare also Di ), at Bethel Gen 35:7 , by Moses at Rephidim Exod 17:15 , Horeb Exod 24:4 , by Balak at Bamoth Baal, Pisgah, & Peor Num 23:1 ; Num 23:14 ; Num 23:29 by Joshua on Mt. Ebal Josh 8:30 : the prophetic histories narrate that altars were built by Gideon at Ophra Judg 6:24 by a man of God at Bethel Judg 21:4 by Samuel at Ramah 1Sam 7:17 by Saul after Michmash 1Sam 14:35 by David on the threshing floor of Ornan 2Sam 24:25 = 1Chr 21:18 ; 1Chr 22:1 that Solomon sacrificed on the altar at Gibeon 1Kgs 3:4 and built altars in the temple at Jerusalem 1Kgs 6:20 ; 1Kgs 8:64 that Jeroboam built an altar at Bethel 1Kgs 12:32 (which was destroyed by Josiah 2Kgs 23:15 ); and that Elijah repaired an ancient altar on Carmel 1Kgs 18:30 . An altar in Egypt is predicted Isa 19:19 . All this accords with the law of the Covenant code Exod 20:24-26 which recognises a plurality of altars and prescribes that they shall be built of אֲדָמָה , or of unhewn stones, and without steps. So אֲבָנִים Deut 27:6 ( J E ), אֲבָנִים שְׁלֵמוֺת Josh 8:31 , and twelve stones 1Kgs 18:30 ; 1Kgs 18:32 compare Isa 27:9 . The altar was also a place of refuge Exod 21:24 ( J E ) 1Kgs 1:50 ; 1Kgs 1:51 ; 1Kgs 2:28 . 2. D prescribes one central altar Deut 12:5 f. 27; but no attempt to enforce this principle appears before Hezekiah( 2Kgs 18:4 ; 2Kgs 18:22 ), and Josiah, whose reform is more effectual, 2Kgs 23:8-20 . 3. P limits sacrifices to the altars of the tabernacle. A great altar was built east of the Jordan, but it was according to P only as an עֵד after the pattern of the altar before the Tabernacle Josh 22:10-34 . Solomon made two altars for the temple at Jerusalem: \ \ a. הַנְּחשֶׁת ׳ מ for the court 1Kgs 8:64 (which was laid aside by Ahaz 2Kgs 16:14 ; 2Kgs 16:15 , who made an altar after the model of one he saw in Damascus 2Kgs 16:11 ); in v 2Kgs 16:14 ׳ הַמִּזְבַּח הַנּ (construct form with article) is erroneous, read probably מִזְבַּח compare Ges «GKC:127»§ 127 . 4 a near the end; this altar, according to Chronicles, measured 20*20*10 cubits 2Chr 4:1 this מזבח (ה)נחשׁת also 2Chr 7:7 & Ezek 9:2 = העולה ׳ מ 2Chr 29:18 , repaired by Asa 2Chr 15:8 \ \ b. an altar of cedar, plated with gold, in the temple before the דְּבִיר 1Kgs 6:20 ; 1Kgs 6:22 ; 1Kgs 7:48 = הזהב ׳ מ 2Chr 4:19 = הַקְּטֹרֶת ׳ מ 1Chr 28:18 ; 2Chr 26:16 . 5.
